newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see light nearby trade in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see light nearby trade in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw light nearby trade this afternoon as many buyers remained sidelined after calls for a weaker Chicago soycomplex opening, market sources said.

"We saw a few nearby trades in soymeal and corngluten and also some nearby business in Malaysian palm expellers as this product was regarded as relatively cheap with fears for a price rise," one broker said.

Afloat Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $350 a tonne cif Rotterdam and afloat Argentine soymeal at $338. Afloat palm expellers traded between $106 and $108 a tonne cif.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
